newsitem.title: USA: Tele Danmark swaps HTC stake. [CORRECTED 19:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark swaps HTC stake. [CORRECTED 19:15 GMT]

text.p: Hungarian Telephone and Cable Corp said it agreed to a deal with Tele Danmark A/S in which Tele Danmark will swap its 20 percent stakes in each of HTC's two operating units for HTC common shares valued at $5.3 million.
HTC said Tele Danmark will receive 420,908 shares of HTC common stock, which indicates a value of $12.57 per share for the HTC shares to be issued.
HTC shares stood at 8-3/4 at midday Tuesday.
Citizens Utilities Co holds 19 percent of the company's common stock with options to buy up to roughly 58 percent of the company's shares.
HTC management owned 2.2 percent of the outstanding shares as of March 31, and close to one percent on a fully diluted basis, HTC's general counsel Peter Noone said.
HTC has 25-year licenses to do business in five operating regions of Hungary. It is currently building out its networks and has about 150,000 subscriber lines in service, a spokesman said.
Tele Danmark also has a 23.2 percent stake in Pannon GSM, a provider of cellular phone services in Hungary.
